write about graphs, charts, and trends.
avoid errors with fall, riseand grow.
A Look at a model Match each graph or chart with two sentences below.Write the letters a-d next
1. The cost of renting a hive rose from $55 to $135 in three years. -
2. There was a decline in the U.S. bee population of approximately 70 percent.
3. The majority of almonds are grown in the United States.
4. The number of bee colonies in the U.S. fell by more than 70 percent.
5. There was an increase in the number of hives worldwide of about 45 percent.
6. The U.S. accounted for over 70 percent of global almond production.
7. Globally, the number of hives increased by roughly 45 percent.
8. There was a rise of just over 145 percent in the cost of hives.
